result.summary: Excluding expected horizontal scroll clipping and bottom-viewport cutoff, found 1 minor visual inconsistency: mismatched favorite-icon background between the two 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has no visible dark circular background, while the pizza card below it shows the heart inside a dark circular background, making the treatment inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use the same favorite-button style across all 'Popular right now' cards with a consistent semi-transparent dark circular background behind the heart for visibility on all images.
